issues: No measurement-integrity problems: no file or network access, no pasted coordinates, no use of labels; the fixed seed is kept.

The cutoff=0.3 option drops no-overlap constraints between far-apart circles during the 40-iteration screening polish, so screened layouts could overlap. This is harmless because _lp_radii(c2) is recomputed on all pairs after every polish.
The diff is cut off after the second-stage _lp_radii call, so the rest of that loop and the return are not shown. I assume they update best the same way the first stage does.

The second stage checks the clock (215 s) only before starting each full polish, so a slow polish could run past 215 s. It will very likely still finish within 300 s, but the margin is not guaranteed.

Each side has only one run, so no spread can be estimated. The difference is exactly 0, so z = 0, matching the harness. There is no improvement over the incumbent's 2.636, so the provisional reject is consistent.
